capabilities: Render footnote references as numbered links in callouts and table cells
Show inline footnotes written as ^[text] as small numbered links
Display a hover preview of the footnote definition with its Markdown drawn
Jump to the definition on click or Enter, and highlight the definition line
List, check, and convert footnotes with Pro commands
extras: Freemium: core rendering is free; a footnote panel, unused/missing footnote checks, and inline-to-named conversion require Pro, unlocked via GitHub Sponsors with device-flow sign-in. The plugin makes no network requests until sign-in and sends no vault data. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. After updates it opens a What's new tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off).
intentEvidence: Live Preview does not do this by itself.
problem: In Obsidian's Live Preview, footnote references inside callouts and table cells show as plain text like [^2] instead of clickable numbered links.

relations.evidence: How is this different from the Footnote Shortcut plugin?
Footnote Shortcut and Tidy Footnotes help you write and tidy footnotes.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Live Preview extension that renders footnote references as clickable numbered links in callouts, table cells, and paragraphs, with hover previews and jump-to-definition.
